create_convert_file_to_markdown: convert a PDF, PPT, Excel, or Word document file to a markdown file using the configured PDF converter
create_extract_outline: extract document headings from a markdown file as a list of title and line number dicts
run_convert_pdf_with_pymupdf4llm: convert a PDF file to markdown using pymupdf4llm with automatic fallback to MarkItDown
run_convert_with_markitdown: convert any supported document file to markdown using MarkItDown
test_convertible_extensions: get the set of file extensions that can be converted to markdown
